test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement required’.

Very early in the morning, at the beginning of January, Opu was lying in bed __waiting for the sun having rose__.

options.text: waited for the sun having rose
waiting for the sun to rise

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrase 'having rose' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be **'waiting for the sun to rise'** to *indicate an action that is expected to happen.*
 
• The phrase** 'having rose**' is grammatically **incorrect** and does not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct sentence is ***'******Very early in the morning, at the beginning of January, Opu was lying in bed ****waiting for* the sun to rise.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When describing an action that is expected or planned to happen, the infinitive form **'to rise'** is used.
 
• The phrase **'having rose**' **incorrectly** uses the **past participle 'rose' **instead of the correct form** 'risen'.**
